# Nymrel Public Source Catalog
> Evidence-bounded metadata for public repositories in the Nymrel GitHub organization.

## Entity
- Company brand: Nymrel (https://nymrel.com)
- Legal entity: JalenBuilds LLC
- Contact: contact@nymrel.com

## Evidence boundary
- Repository descriptions are owner-supplied GitHub metadata, not independent portal validation.
- Source presence does not prove package publication, deployment, adoption, customer activation, or revenue.
- Registry, license, validation, adoption, and revenue states remain unassessed unless stated otherwise.

## Catalog snapshot
- Public repositories: 32
- Source inventory checked: 2026-11-05 UTC
- Latest GitHub releases observed: 3

## Build on Nymrel
Use one component independently at a boundary in an existing stack. Follow its setup guide for the supported installation path.

### Source Read: Keep unavailable sources visible
- Use when: A CI or audit check must distinguish an empty result from a source it could not read.
- Contract: Caller-supplied read outcomes → PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN
- Availability: Tagged source · Python 3.11+
- Setup guide: https://github.com/nymrel/source-read/blob/main/README.md#install-from-the-tagged-source
- Boundary: Your application acquires the source and defines the policy. Source Read preserves the outcome.
- Integration feedback: https://github.com/nymrel/source-read/issues

### Nymrel Agent: Route with metadata you control
- Use when: An orchestrator or browser worker needs a deterministic selection before calling its own model SDK.
- Contract: Model metadata + constraints → selected or blocked plan
- Availability: Unreleased router entry · Node / Worker
- Setup guide: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-agent/blob/main/docs/ROUTER_LIBRARY.md
- Boundary: The proposed @nymrel/agent/router entry needs its exact source candidate. Existing v0.4.1 downloads lack it; the full package still installs its declared dependencies.
- Integration feedback: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-agent/issues

### PermitMesh: Check a proposed software action
- Use when: An agent host needs path, operation, approval and budget checks before dispatching a tool.
- Contract: Permit + proposed action → allow / deny + reason codes
- Availability: Source candidate · Python 3.11–3.14
- Setup guide: https://github.com/nymrel/PermitMesh/blob/main/README.md#thirty-second-demo
- Boundary: Your authenticated host enforces the decision, owns nonce consumption and stops denied actions.
- Integration feedback: https://github.com/nymrel/PermitMesh/issues

### Nymrel Proof Ledger: Hand off a verifiable artifact
- Use when: A build or automation producer needs to send artifact bytes with a receipt another process can verify offline.
- Contract: Artifact + signer record → receipt → configured verifier
- Availability: Source installation · Node / Python
- Setup guide: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-proof-ledger/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md
- Boundary: The verifier supplies a trusted key and checks the artifact. A receipt does not establish execution or signer authority.
- Integration feedback: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-proof-ledger/issues

Integration reports should include the runtime, exact source/artifact version, expected behavior and result; remove credentials and private data. This portal does not measure outside adoption.
